name: Monastery Mentor
oracle_text:
Prowess (Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.)
Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, create a 1/1 white Monk creature token with prowess.
blocked_sentences: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, create a 1/1 white Monk creature token with prowess.

needs.what: a token id for a 1/1 white Monk creature token with prowess, e.g. `monk_1_1_w_prowess` -- a mono-white 1/1 with subtype Monk that carries prowess as a printed ability of its own. It is ONE token definition, not a token plus a keyword: prowess is not one of the 34 loader keywords, but the shipped pool already writes it as a triggered ability (see `agent_of_atlas` in data/cards/auto/templates.cards.json -- kind "triggered", text "Prowess", trigger {"event": "spell_cast", "filter": {"not_types": ["Creature"]}}, effects [{"op": "pump", "objects": {"self_only": true, "zone": "battlefield"}, "power": {"const": 1}, "toughness": {"const": 1}}]), and a token entry may carry printed abilities exactly as `treasure_token` in data/cards/tokens.cards.json carries its activated mana ability. So the new entry is that same triggered ability on a 1/1 white Monk. The same token is printed by Monastery Swiftspear's cycle-mates and by every 'create a 1/1 white Monk creature token with prowess' card, so it closes more than this one.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `token_ids` is a closed list and it has no Monk at all. The nearest white 1/1s in it are `human_1_1_w` (1/1 white Human), `soldier_1_1_w` (1/1 white Soldier) and `human_soldier_1_1_w` (1/1 white Human Soldier), and none of the three is a Monk or has prowess -- substituting one would silently change both the creature type (which Monk-tribal and 'creature type' effects read) and drop the token's entire printed ability, so every copy the Mentor makes would be an inert vanilla 1/1 instead of the engine the card is built around. `create_token` takes only a `token` id: op_options lists `amount`, `as`, `attacking`, `controller`, `tapped` and `token`, with no subtypes, colors, keywords or ability override, so the missing characteristics cannot be spelled from the card. Granting the ability afterwards is not a substitute either -- `grant_ability`/`grant_keyword` would have to name prowess, which is not a loader keyword, and `grant_ability` on a freshly created token would still leave later-made tokens without it.

notes: The token is the ONLY thing blocking this card. Both printed lines are expressible today and the card ships the moment the one-line token id lands. Prowess itself is NOT a gap -- it is a triggered ability the shipped pool already writes.
